headline: Japan Considers Cutting Gasoline Subsidies as Budget Costs Escalate
summary: The Japanese government is weighing reductions in retail gasoline subsidies starting in December, as payments running several billion dollars monthly become difficult to sustain.
why: Japan relies on imported energy. Phasing down fuel price subsidies can raise domestic inflation pressures while easing fiscal strain on Japan's national budget.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Trimming fuel subsidies reduces government fiscal outlays while potentially pushing consumer fuel costs higher.
